_description: Deterministic 5% growth, no tax. Tests that portfolio growth compounds correctly.
_rationale: 500k savings, 5% return (0% stddev = deterministic), 15k/yr spending, 0% inflation. 5% of 500k = 25k growth > 15k spending, so balance grows over time. Closed-form: path[n] = 185000 * 1.05^n + 315000. Never runs out → 100% probability.
name: Fixed Growth No Tax
